learning_outcomes.text: Students expand their acquired knowledge in vocational didactics. They apply their knowledge to didactic questions and problems in designing educational and qualification processes.

Students have an overview of the structures, profiles, and contents of educational and qualification processes in the vocational fields of electrical engineering, automotive engineering, metal technology, and information technology, and their impact on the design of educational and qualification processes.

Students explain the current state and development trends of didactic guiding principles, curricular frameworks, and their didactic implications. They assess options and conditions for the use of concepts and methods from a didactic perspective.

Students possess didactic competence; they can plan, implement, and evaluate teaching and training suitable for the target group, also with regard to heterogeneous learning groups. They evaluate and apply learned strategies and methods for designing vocational teaching and learning processes.
Students apply procedures and instruments for analyzing vocational teaching and learning processes and vocational competence development, and assess their development needs.
Students can professionally discuss subject-specific didactic tasks and problems with other experts.
Students evaluate their level of professionalization, also in exchange with fellow students.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental theories and models of work, cognitive, and learning psychology and their application to the design of vocational teaching and learning processes.
Selection and structuring of suitable learning and teaching content for vocational education and qualification processes, also considering sustainability aspects.
Subject-specific didactic foundations of action- and competence-oriented learning in initial and continuing vocational training.
Strategies and methods for designing vocational teaching and learning processes, also with regard to heterogeneous learning groups.
Planning and design of vocational education and qualification processes in the vocational fields of electrical engineering / automotive engineering / information technology / metal technology.
Professionalism and competence profiles of teachers in vocational education.
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a term paper of 15 to 25 pages. The workload for the module is 150 hours.
